decks.notes: This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck, classified as Aggro - Bazaar Aggro, focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing powerful creatures like Vengevine, Hollow One, Blazing Rootwalla, and Master of Death. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void, Mental Misstep, and Mindbreak Trap to slow down opponents. It utilizes the unique ability of Bazaar of Baghdad to enable graveyard-based strategies, allowing for powerful interactions with cards like Squee, Goblin Nabob and Noxious Revival. Additionally, it includes a strong suite of Force spells (Force of Will, Force of Negation, Force of Vigor) to protect its game plan.

This is an Aggro - Fish deck with Lurrus of the Dream-Den as the companion. The key concept of this deck is to maintain a low curve and apply constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. It aims to utilize efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Questing Druid while using disruption spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the board. The deck also includes card advantage through spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, as well as powerful mana acceleration with Moxen and fetch lands.

The key concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana through cards like Tolarian Academy, Grim Monolith, and Mishra's Workshop, while also utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Coveted Jewel to draw a significant number of cards. This deck aims to assemble a combination of cards, such as Time Vault and Voltaic Key or Mishra's Workshop and The One Ring, to create a powerful win condition. The deck also includes disruption through cards like Force of Will to protect its combo pieces. Overall, the key concept is to generate and leverage large amounts of mana for a powerful combo finish.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to use powerful control spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing card advantage engines like Dark Confidant and Sensei's Divining Top to maintain a steady stream of resources. The deck also aims to generate additional value through cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Urza's Saga, while utilizing disruptive cards like Wasteland and Pithing Needle to keep the opponent off balance. Overall, the strategy focuses on controlling the game tempo and out-valuing the opponent in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on using control elements and engineering tactics to dominate the game. It heavily relies on artifacts and fast mana to generate quick advantage. The key concept of this deck is to disrupt opponents' strategies and maintain control through cards like Force of Will, Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, and Spell Pierce. It also has a strong emphasis on artifact synergy with cards like Urza's Saga, Goblin Engineer, and Manifold Key. The goal is to outmaneuver opponents and win through card advantage, disruption, and strategic plays.

This deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay using a combination of powerful spells and efficient creatures. It aims to take control of the game early on by disrupting the opponent's strategy and applying pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Questing Druid. The deck also utilizes versatile spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to maintain board control. Overall, the key concept is to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield and force the opponent to react to the fast and aggressive plays of the Fish archetype.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on using a combination of powerful spells and disruptive abilities to control the game and outmaneuver the opponent. By utilizing versatile cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Ancestral Recall, along with mana accelerants like Moxen and Lotus, the deck aims to establish early dominance and maintain control throughout the game. With efficient removal like Fatal Push and disruptive spells like Flusterstorm, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions, such as using Time Vault with Manifold Key for a quick victory.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counter spells, card advantage, and disruptive plays. Key cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Flusterstorm are used to disrupt opponent's plays, while cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm provide card advantage. The deck also includes key artifacts like Sol Ring, Black Lotus, and Time Vault to generate mana and take extra turns. With a focus on disrupting the opponent's strategy and generating advantage with card draw, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck aims to quickly combo off by milling your entire deck with cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, allowing you to play Thassa's Oracle and win the game on the spot. The deck focuses on fast mana acceleration and ways to protect your combo pieces, using cards like Force of Will and Pact of Negation to disrupt opponents. It also includes cards like Tinker and Demonic Tutor to search for key combo pieces when needed. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to win the game in a single turn.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using counterspells and removal spells to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes powerful artifacts like Time Vault, Mana Crypt, and the Moxen to ramp up its resources and gain an advantage. It also includes powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to search for key cards or answers to specific threats. The deck aims to stay in control of the game by countering or removing threats while gradually building up its own board presence and card advantage.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly and efficiently to cast powerful spells and activate game-winning combos. It utilizes cards like Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith to ramp up mana production, while also utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Tinker to draw cards and search for key combo pieces. The ultimate goal is to assemble the combination of Coveted Jewel, Manifold Key, and Karn, the Great Creator to generate an overwhelming advantage and secure victory.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - Fish deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Questing Druid, backed up by disruptive spells such as Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. In addition, the deck runs mana acceleration in the form of Moxen and cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and powerful utility lands like Strip Mine and Boseiju, Who Endures.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 combo deck revolves around the Dredge mechanic. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Ichorid, Stinkweed Imp, and Golgari Thug, while utilizing cards such as Serum Powder and Bazaar of Baghdad to dig through the deck. Once the graveyard is packed, the deck can bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Hollow One for free, triggering their abilities and overwhelming the opponent. Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection, while Silversmote Ghoul and Grief offer additional value and disruption.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - Bazaar Aggro deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Squee, Goblin Nabob to fuel powerful plays with Vengevine and Hollow One. The deck also utilizes Force spells to protect its key threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Noxious Revival and Serum Powder help to further optimize the deck's consistency and graveyard strategy, making it a fast-paced and disruptive aggro deck that aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game.

The deck aims to quickly assemble an infinite mana combo using cards like Time Vault, Grim Monolith, and Mana Vault. By generating large amounts of mana, it can cast powerful spells like Tinker to find key combo pieces such as Coveted Jewel. The deck also uses cards like Paradoxical Outcome to draw through the deck quickly and protect the combo with counterspells like Force of Will. The presence of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge provide additional utility and alternate win conditions, making the deck versatile and deadly in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck is focused on playing aggressively while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with hatebears. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent's spells, as well as cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine to disrupt their mana base, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures. The deck also includes powerful bombs like Archon of Emeria and Emeria's Call to quickly close out the game.
